description: Splash/share damage buff. When the owner takes damage, distributes damage to nearby enemies. Has two modes: direct pass-through (type 0) or percentage-based (type 1).

param1.description: Calculation type. 0 = pass full damage to targets. 1 = apply percentage of damage to targets.

param2.description: Percentage value (divided by 10000 on alloc). Used only for calType 1.

param5.description: param5[0] = target count filter param, param5[1] = TargetFilter type for getTargets

onShareDamageAction.description: Called when the buff owner takes damage. Distributes damage to enemy targets.

parameters.source: The unit that dealt the damage
parameters.healthType: The type of damage (Hurt, Hurt_Crit, etc.)

calType_1.name: Percentage-based Splash
calType_1.each_target: If target is NOT the source: healthTarget(target, splashDamage, healthType); If target IS the source: healthTarget(target, roundInt(originalDamage + splashDamage), healthType)

healthType_mapping.crit: Hurt_Share_Damage_Crit (if original was Hurt_Crit or Hurt_Double_Crit)

notes: This buff is passive - onBegin does nothing. Damage sharing is triggered externally when the owner receives damage.
